import subprocess

# Final verification of all observable behaviors
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', '''
from boltons.iterutils import split, split_iter, partition

print("=== m1: split maxsplit=0 ===")
r1 = list(split([1, 2, 3], sep=None, maxsplit=0))
print(f"list(split([1, 2, 3], sep=None, maxsplit=0)) == [[1, 2, 3]]: {r1 == [[1, 2, 3]]}")

r2 = split('abc', sep=None, maxsplit=0)
print(f"split('abc', sep=None, maxsplit=0) == 'abc': {r2 == 'abc'}")

print("\n=== m2: partition single predicate ===")
r3 = partition([1, 2, 3], lambda x: x > 1)
print(f"partition([1, 2, 3], lambda x: x > 1) == ([2, 3], [1]): {r3 == ([2, 3], [1])}")

print("\n=== m2: partition multiple predicates ===")
r4 = partition([1, 2, 3], [lambda x: x > 1, lambda x: x < 3])
print(f"partition([1, 2, 3], [lambda x: x > 1, lambda x: x < 3]) == ([2], [1], [3])")
print(f"  Got: {r4}")
print(f"  Expected: ([2], [1], [3])")
print(f"  Match: {r4 == ([2], [1], [3])}")

# Additional tests for robustness
print("\n=== Additional tests ===")
# Empty source
r5 = partition([], lambda x: x > 0)
print(f"partition([], ...) == ([], []): {r5 == ([], [])}")

# String key (attribute name)
class Obj:
    def __init__(self, v): self.v = v
r6 = partition([Obj(0), Obj(1)], 'v')
print(f"partition with string key works: {len(r6[0]) + len(r6[1]) == 2}")

# Multiple preds with no matches
r7 = partition([1, 2, 3], [lambda x: x > 100])
print(f"partition with unmatched pred: {r7}")

# Generator source
r8 = list(split((x for x in [1, 2, 3]), maxsplit=0))
print(f"split from generator with maxsplit=0: {r8}")
'''], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[:500])
